Meltan

Steel

Alola · Generation 7 · Mythical Pokémon

Meltan is a Steel-type Hex Nut Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 8 kg. It evolves into Melmetal. Its highest base stat is Attack (65), with a base stat total of 300.
